_doc: AU ground-truth annotations — OWNER-APPROVED 2026-10-05 (visually grounded by contact-sheet review). Owner rulings applied: (1) S02_A departure begins at GEAR-UP (0s) not walk-out; (2) S02_D = departure/threshold-crossing; (3) S07_A = companionship partial + useful_elsewhere; (4) S08_D = EATING a pouch meal (filename 'cooking' is a hallucination trap, kept as-is); (5) S08_F = BREAKFAST not dinner, strong_elsewhere (filename kept as-is); (6) S04_A tiny person confirmed present. These are now the AU evaluation scoring ground truth. shot/beat contribution reuses C4 vocabulary where it applies; story_utility ∈ {none, useful_elsewhere, strong_elsewhere}.

owner_approved.filenames: kept as-is on purpose — fixture names encode requested capture intent, not footage content

capture_context.shot_purpose: clean steady shot of the subject

observed_events.description: a red hiking backpack stands on the floor beside a green sofa; camera static, no action

useful_segments.why_useful: clean steady object shot of the gear, usable throughout

clips.temporal_order: no temporal development — single continuous static object shot
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — clean steady shot of the backpack object
ambiguity_flags: OVER-SEGMENTATION CONTROL: a model that emits >1 event here is over-segmenting a single static shot

capture_context.shot_purpose: clean steady shot of the subject

observed_events.description: backpack fills the lower frame while the camera is aimed up and past it at a shelf/cabinet; subject not properly framed

dead_or_setup_segments.note: camera points away from the intended subject; whole clip is effectively unusable framing

clips.temporal_order: no meaningful order; very short mis-aimed clip
clips.requested_shot_contribution: unfulfilled — subject not framed; camera points away
ambiguity_flags: HALLUCINATION CONTROL: there is no clean subject shot here; a model claiming a good object shot is hallucinating usefulness

capture_context.shot_purpose: steady clear shot of the backpack as object of the moment

observed_events.description: red hiking backpack stands on the floor by a sofa indoors; static, no action (same footage as T01_A)

useful_segments.why_useful: clean steady gear/object shot, usable throughout

clips.temporal_order: no temporal development — single continuous static object shot
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — establishes the backpack object clearly
ambiguity_flags: OVER-SEGMENTATION CONTROL (shares physical footage with T01_A_clean_4s)

capture_context.shot_purpose: steady clear shot of the backpack as object

observed_events.description: backpack and trekking poles lean against a railing with red geranium flowers; alpine village street
camera pans up/across to a pink alpine church and parked cars on the village street
camera continues to stone village buildings and a parking area

useful_segments.why_useful: gear-in-place against a scenic village backdrop — an alternative 'object' shot with context
establishing shot of the pink church / village — strong place-establishing material

clips.temporal_order: gear foreground first, then camera reveals the village/church — object-then-place pan
clips.requested_shot_contribution: alternative_fulfilled — gear shown but as part of a wider village establishing pan, not a tight object hold
clips.requested_beat_contribution: loosely serves beat_object; also strong establishing material for a place/arrival beat
ambiguity_flags: Is the primary subject the gear or the village? Reasonable annotators could split. Flagged as object+place.

observed_events.description: woman shoulders a large red backpack indoors (putting it on / adjusting)
she walks across the room toward the camera, fastening the hip belt
close pass of her face/pack, then she moves into a hotel corridor
she walks away down the corridor (back to camera), departing
she turns back toward camera at the far end

useful_segments.why_useful: complete departure action — gear-up is PART of the departure (owner ruling): shoulders the pack, walks out, proceeds down the hall

clips.temporal_order: indoor gear-up FIRST (part of the departure), then walk toward camera, then depart down the corridor — a departure (outbound) that begins at gear-up
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — clearly communicates departure/beginning of journey; departure begins at gear-up (0s)
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): departure begins at GEAR-UP (0s), not the walk-out. The 0-4s gear-up is departure material, not setup.

capture_context.shot_purpose: communicate departure (instruction: walk toward camera down hallway)

observed_events.description: closed dark door, nobody visible
woman with backpack steps OUT through the doorway into the corridor
she walks TOWARD the camera down the corridor, ending in close-up

useful_segments.why_useful: emerging through a doorway and approaching — a threshold-crossing / setting-out beat

clips.temporal_order: emerges THROUGH a door then walks toward the camera — reads as setting out / crossing a threshold (approach to camera, a deviation from 'walk away')
clips.requested_shot_contribution: alternative_fulfilled — communicates setting-out via a doorway, though the motion is toward (not away from) camera
clips.requested_beat_contribution: serves beat_departure as a threshold-crossing variant
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): this is DEPARTURE / threshold-crossing. She crosses a threshold then approaches camera; scored as departure, not arrival.

observed_events.description: woman stands by a mirror; backpack resting on a chair beside her
she lifts the backpack off the chair and swings it onto her back (gearing up)
she adjusts the pack / straps, still standing in place
she bends to the chair again; remains indoors, has not left

useful_segments.why_useful: gearing-up / preparation action — useful for a 'getting ready' beat, not departure

clips.temporal_order: picks pack up and puts it on, stays indoors — PREPARATION, not departure (no exit happens). Contradicts the requested departure.
clips.requested_beat_contribution: does not serve beat_departure; could serve a 'preparation' beat
ambiguity_flags: TEMPORAL-HARD: must NOT be read as departure. A model calling this 'departure' has mis-ordered intent vs action.

capture_context.shot_purpose: reveal landscape by moving from friend to vista (friend->landscape)

observed_events.description: frame holds on jagged snow-capped mountains / alpine vista above larch trees (landscape FIRST)
camera tilts/pans DOWN to the dirt trail through the trees
a hiker with trekking poles appears on the trail and walks toward camera (person revealed LAST)

useful_segments.why_useful: strong landscape/vista reveal footage on its own
person-on-trail footage, usable for progression/companion beats

clips.temporal_order: LANDSCAPE first, then camera moves down to reveal the PERSON last — this is landscape->person, the REVERSE of the requested friend->landscape reveal
clips.requested_beat_contribution: does not serve beat_reveal as specified; the vista itself is still strong place material
ambiguity_flags: TEMPORAL-HARD / REVEAL-DIRECTION: the key signal is landscape-first/person-last. A model must get the direction, not just 'has person and landscape'.

capture_context.shot_purpose: show progression deeper into the landscape

observed_events.description: camera follows a hiker (trekking poles) from behind up a forested alpine trail; sustained progression
camera tilts up off the hiker to the snow-capped mountains ahead; hiker leaves frame

useful_segments.why_useful: clean follow-behind progression — the requested shot
mountains-ahead vista — bonus establishing/payoff material

clips.temporal_order: follow the hiker uphill FIRST, then reveal the mountains ahead — progression into the landscape
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — forward progression along the trail
ambiguity_flags: Two mild segments (follow, then vista). >2 events would be over-segmentation of a single sustained walk.

observed_events.description: woman with large pack walks AWAY down a hotel corridor toward a door
she opens the door and ENTERS a hotel room
inside, she moves to a table and sets the backpack DOWN
she stands in the room, pack off — settled/arrived

useful_segments.why_useful: entering a room and setting the pack down — a clean ARRIVAL/settling beat

clips.temporal_order: walks to a door, ENTERS a room, puts the pack DOWN — this is ARRIVAL (ending a journey), the OPPOSITE of the requested departure
clips.requested_shot_contribution: unfulfilled (contradicted) — footage shows arrival, request asked for departure
clips.requested_beat_contribution: does not serve beat_departure; serves an arrival/end-of-day beat
ambiguity_flags: TEMPORAL-HARD / ARRIVAL-vs-DEPARTURE: a model that reads 'backpack + corridor' as departure has fallen for the surface cue and missed the enter+set-down ordering.

capture_context.shot_purpose: establish scale contrast between small human and large landscape

observed_events.description: cloud-draped ridgelines and a deep valley; mostly landscape, no clear person
a tiny human figure appears on the ridgeline, dwarfed by the mountains

useful_segments.why_useful: small-person-against-large-landscape — the scale-contrast payoff

clips.temporal_order: landscape first, tiny person enters on the ridge later — scale contrast established when the figure appears
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — small person in large landscape (scale contrast)
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): confirmed a tiny person DOES appear (~3.5s). GT asserts a person is present — this is a RECALL PROBE; a model that misses the human is evidence/attention-limited, not correct.

observed_events.description: a hiker carrying a pack wades carefully across a wide, braided glacial river, mountains behind; sustained effortful crossing
a second tiny figure appears at far left near the end

useful_segments.why_useful: the full river crossing — strong difficulty/effort material with a clear start and end

clips.temporal_order: one continuous river crossing from near bank to far; effort evident in careful footing
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — river crossing clearly conveys difficulty/effort
ambiguity_flags: OVER-SEGMENTATION PROBE: this is ONE sustained crossing. Many 'events' (each step) = over-segmentation. The late 2nd figure is a minor real detail.

observed_events.description: a person in a blue jacket reclines/rests on a grassy alpine slope under a big sky; mostly still, resting (one companion, foreground red garment)
other hikers appear climbing the slope in the background (people arriving/passing on the trail)
camera turns to a selfie — a face fills the frame at the end (camera being lowered/turned)

useful_segments.why_useful: resting-on-the-slope companion footage — calm end-of-effort / togetherness mood
other hikers on the slope — potential people/scale/trail-life material

dead_or_setup_segments.note: end selfie / camera turning — tail material, likely not usable as companion footage

clips.temporal_order: long static resting FIRST (~0-55s), THEN other hikers appear (~55s), THEN end selfie (~90s) — a late second event after a long quiet stretch
clips.requested_shot_contribution: partially — shows a companion resting; genuine two-person interaction is weak, mostly one reclining person + distant others
clips.requested_beat_contribution: loosely serves beat_companion (people present) but not a strong interaction moment
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): companionship PARTIAL + story_utility useful_elsewhere (mostly one reclining person; distant others appear late — not a strong two-person interaction).
OVER-SEGMENTATION PROBE (long static front): 0-55s is ONE continuous resting state, not many events.
MULTI-EVENT RECALL PROBE: the late appearance of other hikers (~55s) is a distinct second event a model must RECALL despite the long quiet lead-in.

observed_events.description: several hikers in bright jackets (green/pink/orange packs) climb a dark rocky ridge; filmed from behind at a distance; the shooter's own foot is visible at bottom (POV)

useful_segments.why_useful: trail-life / other-hikers-on-the-ridge footage — usable as atmosphere, not as the user's companions

clips.temporal_order: one continuous shot of strangers ascending; no strong internal ordering
clips.requested_shot_contribution: unfulfilled — the people are strangers/other hikers, not the requested companion
ambiguity_flags: SEMANTIC: 'has people' must NOT be read as 'companionship fulfilled'. The people are the wrong people. Key GOOD-FOOTAGE-WRONG-SHOT case.

observed_events.description: two people at an outdoor table in cold weather; one holds up and opens a dehydrated meal pouch (chicken fried rice)
they eat from an orange bowl together; a hand close-up (~35s) and a close-up of the food in the bowl (~39s)
sustained eating and quiet interaction; the woman in blue eats, looks around, talks intermittently
camera turns toward a selfie; a face fills the frame at the very end

useful_segments.why_useful: opening/holding the meal pouch — a clear 'preparing/eating dinner' beat with a beginning
quiet eating-together footage — strong end-of-day companionship/mood material

dead_or_setup_segments.note: a hand close-up / near-abstract frame — low-value filler
end selfie / camera turning — tail material

clips.temporal_order: pouch opened FIRST, then eating together, long sustained eating, then an end selfie — a meal from start toward finish
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled — a calm end-of-day eating moment conveys the winding-down mood
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): confirmed EATING a pre-made pouch meal, NOT cooking. Filename kept as-is on purpose (it encodes the requested intent, not the content) — a model that says 'cooking' is reading the label and scores as a hallucination.
OVER-SEGMENTATION PROBE: 90s of sustained eating is NOT dozens of events.
SEGMENTATION PROBE: can a model find the dead hand-close-up (~35s) and the end selfie?

observed_events.description: a bowl of muesli, a bread roll and fruit on a restaurant table; a hand with chopsticks reaches in
camera pans up/right to reveal snow-capped mountains through the restaurant window

useful_segments.why_useful: the meal on the table — a settling/meal detail
the alpine mountain view through the window — strong, beautiful place material

clips.temporal_order: food on the table FIRST, then camera reveals the mountain window view — meal-to-vista reveal
clips.requested_shot_contribution: fulfilled for mood (a calm meal with a view) — reads as a quiet moment, though the view is the real payoff
clips.requested_beat_contribution: serves beat_endofday; also strong place/establishing material
ambiguity_flags: RESOLVED (owner 2026-10-05): confirmed BREAKFAST (muesli), not dinner; filename kept as-is (requested intent, not content). story_utility strong_elsewhere stands — the beauty/payoff is the window vista, not the food.

capture_context.shot_purpose: convey the DIFFICULTY of the hike

observed_events.description: a gentle sunlit alpine trail with blue sky; a tiny hiker is a distant speck approaching
the hiker approaches steadily, growing from distant to near; relaxed, easy walking with trekking poles
camera pans off to the green valley below

useful_segments.why_useful: beautiful easy approach on a scenic trail — strong landscape/approach material

clips.temporal_order: distant speck FIRST, grows to a near figure — a long easy approach; relaxed, NOT difficult
clips.requested_shot_contribution: unfulfilled — footage is beautiful and easy, does NOT convey difficulty/effort
clips.requested_beat_contribution: does not serve beat_difficulty; serves a scenic/approach beat strongly
ambiguity_flags: SEMANTIC: 'has a hiker on a mountain trail' must NOT be read as 'difficulty conveyed'. Beautiful-but-wrong-purpose, valuable elsewhere.
Shared physical footage with A06 (different requested beat).

capture_context.shot_purpose: convey the DIFFICULTY of the hike

observed_events.description: gentle sunlit alpine trail, blue sky; a tiny hiker is a distant speck (SAME footage as A01)
the hiker approaches steadily, growing from distant to near; relaxed easy walking
camera pans to the valley below

useful_segments.why_useful: beautiful easy approach on a scenic trail

clips.temporal_order: distant speck first, grows nearer — long easy approach; NOT difficult
clips.requested_shot_contribution: unfulfilled — beautiful but does not convey the requested difficulty beat
clips.requested_beat_contribution: does not serve beat_difficulty as requested; strong elsewhere as scenic material
ambiguity_flags: SHARED-SOURCE CONTROL: identical footage to A01 under the same requested beat here — raw observed events MUST match A01; only the Story-contribution framing may differ. A model giving materially different OBSERVED events for the same bytes is unstable.
